addition.item: First public release for Joomla 6 / PHP 8.3+
Article comments via context + item_id with SSR first page, guest email OTP, registered users, replies, likes, reports, and subscriptions
Bot protection: Proof of Work, Google reCAPTCHA v2, Cloudflare Turnstile
Admin moderation, bans, per-item overrides, privacy export/erase, and background job queue
Multi-context Comments-side policies for Video, Business, and Events (enable_* default Off until host thin plugins + pair-QA)
Denylist exclusions and Latest Comments module source selector

fix.item: Schema installer no longer clamps #__schemas versions >= 1.1.0 back to 1.0.38
Unified creationDate to 2026-10-21 across package manifests
Clarified Settings Cache help text: Joomla cache switch does not control Cloudflare purge (credentials in DevArt Utils)

note.item: Install or update using the full pkg_devartcomments package only
First public release (1.1.0); safe install on a new site or update from late 1.0.x development builds
Cloudflare URL purge requires DevArt Utils with Cloudflare credentials configured
Keep enable_video / enable_business / enable_events Off until the matching host thin plugin is installed and pair-QA passes
